Categories, Classes and Units of Organization, are examples of...

Not all Categories are of equal weight. Not all Statistics reveal meaningful information.

## The central problem

Potentiality is unmanageable, precisely becuase we eventually must map objects to value. Every decision eventually rests on systems of value.

Why can't we process multiple parallel options? Multiple arbitrary possibilities? Why not arbitrary possitiblities?

We work with ideas, which may be described as sponteneous seeds from potentiality... though this is largely non observable..
